brief:
Israeli forces and illegal settlers intensified operations across the occupied West Bank on Thursday, conducting widespread invasions, abductions, and shootings targeting Palestinians, according to IMEMC News. The military campaign also included land confiscation and demolition orders affecting Palestinian homes and property throughout the territory.

The escalation represented a significant uptick in combined military and settler activity across multiple locations in the West Bank. Operations targeted both civilian populations and infrastructure, with violations extending to residential areas and agricultural land held by Palestinians.
